description: Lists the cities Argento covers (Argentine community guides abroad) with country, time zone, current local time, airports and the canonical page of each city. Optionally filter by country (ISO code like ES or name). Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

country.description: Country ISO 3166-1 code (ES, IT, US…) or name in Spanish.

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

name: list_cities
title: List Argento cities
